whatTheFirstCaptureShowedAndWhatChanged.before: one caption at one height per body. Raiders bunch — they all walk to the same larder tile — so five of the six names were printed on top of one another and the second line was clipped by the label width.
whatTheFirstCaptureShowedAndWhatChanged.after: captions that would collide take the next band up (ReturningHeroLabel.Layout), the label is 130 reference pixels wide instead of 80, and a returner without a scar gets one line instead of two.

whatToLookAt: whether the returning raiders read as people you have met — and whether knowing that changes what you do in wave 4. That question cannot be closed by a test run and is the playtest question of the slice.
